question:
**Select the most appropriate option to complete the given sentence.**

His brother _________ his ________ and gave him a watch after his result.
solution:
The correct answer is: **kept, promise**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• **Took**: Lay hold of something with one's hands. (किसी चीज को अपने हाथों से पकड़ना)
 
• **Word**: A single unit of language that has meaning and can be spoken or written. (शब्द)
 
• **Broke**: Having completely run out of money. (पूरी तरह से पैसा खत्म हो जाना)
 
• **Record**: Set down in writing or some other permanent form for later reference. (अभिलेख)
 
• **Lost**: That has been taken away or cannot be recovered. (खोया)
 
• **Temper**: A person's state of mind seen in terms of their being angry or calm. (मिजाज़)
 
• **Kept**: Especially of promises or contracts not violated or disregarded. (विशेष रूप से वादों या अनुबंधों का उल्लंघन या अवहेलना नहीं करना)
 
• **Promise**: A declaration or assurance that one will do something or that a particular thing will happen. (एक घोषणा या आश्वासन कि कोई कुछ करेगा या कोई विशेष बात होगी)
 
 
 
• **To keep a promise** is a phrase that means **to do what you said you would do**.
 
 
• Example: Will they **keep their promises** and stand firm when the going gets tough?
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words "**kept**" and "**promise**" is the most appropriate choice.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: His brother fulfilled his word and offered him a watch as a reward for his performance.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 

**Complete sentence: ***His brother **kept __**his **__promise__**** **and gave him a watch after his result.*
